# Vendor tuning software

`Y_Series_Stepper_Driver_Debug_Software_V1.2.7.zip` was linked directly from
both official ESS23-RS10 and ESS23-RS20 product pages on 2026-10-02.

Source: [STEPPERONLINE's GitHub archive](https://github.com/StepperOnline/Tunning-Software/blob/main/Y_Series_Stepper_Driver_Debug_Software_V1.2.7.zip).

The archive contains `STEPPERONLINE Stepper driver testing software V1.2.7.exe`.
It is a Windows commissioning/tuning tool, not an open-source driver example.
It has been downloaded and its ZIP integrity checked; it has not been executed
or tested with a motor. Keep it as a reference for later manual commissioning.
